name: saimotv-lab
description: SaimoTV Lab — implementação educacional e independente (Fase 05). Nao usa codigo-fonte do alvo investigado.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/shared build && bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/api lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/shared test && bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
